title: rules.version.retired.v1
description: Written to the Rule Engine outbox in the transaction where a published version is retired: by hand (POST .../versions/{v}:retire, RLE-026), or as superseded once a newer approved version is in effect, at approval or by the lifecycle sweep (RLE-027). Written exactly once per retirement across replicas (ADR-0025 decision 2). The outbox row id is the event id. Additive changes only within v1 (DESIGN section 3.3).

eventId.description: The event id, a ULID; equal to the outbox row id. Consumers de-duplicate by it.

occurredAt.description: When the state change committed, ISO 8601 UTC.

tenantId.description: The tenant, from the authenticated context; never from a request body.

correlationId.description: The caller's correlation id (X-Correlation-Id, or the one passed to the Java API). When the caller gave none, the event id: the event starts its own chain.

causationId.description: The id of the command or event that caused this one, or null when a caller's command caused it directly.

producer.description: rule-engine, a slash and the engine version that wrote the event.

schemaVersion.description: Version of the envelope layout; 1 for every .v1 type.

version.description: Version number of the retired version, not the lock version.

actor.description: Who retired it; always equal to retiredBy.

retiredBy.description: The identity that retired the version by hand, or lifecycle.system-actor (default system:supersession; the system: namespace is refused for callers) when it was superseded.

reason.description: The reason given by hand, or SUPERSEDED. At most lifecycle.reason-max-length characters.

supersededBy.description: The version number that took over when superseded; null for a retirement by hand.

retiredAt.description: From this instant evaluation no longer selects the version; a clock before it still does.

noVersionInEffect.description: True when the retirement left the rule set with no version in effect, so evaluations fail until a new version is approved (PD-101); false when another version remains in effect or the version was superseded.

approvalMode.description: single for a retirement by one rules:approve holder (lifecycle.retire-approval, PD-080), four-eyes when a second holder confirmed it (from M3), system when superseded.

requestedBy.description: The requester in four-eyes mode; null otherwise.
